subject: Discovery recap — purchase channel decision tree & approver roster
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@harborcloud.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap — purchase channel decision tree & approver roster

Alicia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key notes from call:
- Purchase channels under consideration: PO (standard SOW + net30), Corporate Card (one-time CC payment), and AWS Marketplace listing (marketplace contract + transactable listing).
- HarborCloud preference today: leaning PO for initial pilot due to vendor controls, but interested in marketplace for future ease of procurement.
- Procurement team will require a short questionnaire and SOW; budget owner is David Lee (VP Finance), finance sponsor is Emily Tran (Accounting Manager), and legal signatory typically sits with Contracts (Carla Ruiz). You confirmed that procurement@harborcloud.com should be looped in.

Proposed next steps (action owners and timeframe):
1) I will share a draft SOW and redline-friendly SOW summary by EOD tomorrow — (Attachment: SOW-Redwood-v0.2.pdf).
2) Alicia / HarborCloud: confirm whether procurement prefers a redlined Word SOW or an uploaded PDF to the portal; confirm the DocuSign/portal contact (procurement@harborcloud.com is fine). Requested by Thu 12/3.
3) If PO is the path, we need the billing contact and PO process owner so we can drop in standard PO instructions into the SOW. If Card is chosen, we will share the single-invoice flow for card payment.
4) Internal intro call: propose a 30-min procurement sync next week to align on paperwork and timeline (David / Emily / procurement). I can coordinate.

Open questions for you: 
- Can you confirm the contract signatory (name + title) and whether Legal requires any specific indemnity/insurance language above our standard?
- Is HarborCloud open to a Marketplace pilot for a limited subset of seats after the initial 90-day pilot?

Attachments: SOW-Redwood-v0.2.pdf (PDF, 84 KB)

Thanks — I’ll wait for your confirmation on PO vs card vs marketplace and the names for the procurement intro.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

---

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@harborcloud.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@harborcloud.com, David Lee <david.lee@harborcloud.com>, Emily Tran <emily.tran@harborcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — purchase channel decision tree & approver roster

Thanks Rishi — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We do expect to go PO for the pilot. Our standard approach is PO + net30. Procurement prefers a Word/Docx SOW that they can redline; uploading a PDF to the portal slows things down.
- Confirmed approvers: David Lee (VP Finance) is the budget owner and will sign off on the PO; Emily Tran will shepherd the invoice and payment details; Carla Ruiz in Legal will be the final contract signatory.
- I’ve attached our procurement questionnaire which procurement asked us to collect from vendors (harborcloud-procurement-questions.xlsx).

Procurement contact (for scheduling and portal uploads): procurement@harborcloud.com. Please send the editable SOW to that address and cc David + Emily. 

We are also open to a Marketplace pilot after 90 days, but legal wants to see the SOW language first. 

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships | HarborCloud
alicia.gomez@harborcloud.com | +1 206-555-0199

Keeping this short — items I’ll own internally to accelerate: 
1) I’ll take the SOW draft Rishi produces and create a redline-friendly Word version (we should send both .docx + PDF).
2) I’ll prepare a one-page Procurement Summary (PO instructions + Redwood bank remittance + contact) to append to the SOW for HarborCloud finance.
3) I’ll draft a minimal insurance clause alternative in case Carla pushes for expanded language so Legal has something to review quickly.

Mapping of approvers (so we have it on record):
- Economic buyer / budget owner: David Lee (HarborCloud, VP Finance) — approvals gate.
- Finance sponsor / invoice owner: Emily Tran (Accounting Manager) — processes PO and invoice matching.
- Contract signatory: Carla Ruiz (Legal) — final signature.

I’ll queue the procurement intro invite for next Tue/Wed and include procurement@harborcloud.com. Rishi — send the editable SOW and I’ll take it from there.

-Jordan
